items.prompt: Original HANZI.OS Mandarin lesson illustration, landscape 3:2, soft painterly editorial art with muted jade/cream warm wood. Two adults in a corridor with TWO distinct closed wooden doors visible side by side. One adult has one hand wrapped in a simple clean white support bandage, no blood, holds a small bag in the other arm and asks a friend for help, gesturing gently toward the nearer door. Friend is reaching toward the nearer door handle, looking back to confirm which door. Educational context: sore hand, politely ask to open THIS door rather than the other door. Show both separate door handles clearly. No text, labels, numbers or watermark.

Original HANZI.OS Mandarin lesson illustration, landscape 3:2 soft painterly editorial style muted jade teal warm wood. Two adult friends planning dinner, sitting together at a small home kitchen table with a simple closed blank menu leaflet, one gestures toward a nearby restaurant visible across the street through a window. Kitchen is tidy with NO meal prepared, empty plates stacked on counter, both friends conversing and deciding where to eat. No food dishes on table, no fish/meat pictured as already served. Exact choice of fish, green tea and meeting time will be in the lesson dialogue, not written in image. No text or numbers, no logo, no watermark, original calm scene.

Original HANZI.OS Mandarin lesson illustration landscape 3:2, polished soft painterly art muted jade cream warm wood. Clothing store, customer and shop assistant comparing exactly TWO pairs of trousers hanging from a shared display rail at SAME waist height: BLACK full-length trousers on LEFT noticeably longer, BLUE ankle-length trousers on RIGHT shorter by about 15 centimeters. Both hem edges entirely visible, adult clothing, not shorts. Customer points to shorter BLUE pair, assistant holds the hanger.
